text:
maria: Quick sync — we've got dependent PRs that need a merge ordering: SDK #4321 needs API #289 landing first; console change in #78 references the new API shape; helm chart bump in infra/helm#12 must land after runtime image tag is published. Can we coordinate a plan? :eyes:

alex: I can finish SDK review today, but the SDK tests hit the API contract change. If API merges first I can re-run and cut a follow-up. ETA ~2pm PT.

jon: I'm blocked on e2e in runtime because the helm values still point to image: redwood/runtime:staging. Failing step:
```
Error: container image not found: redwood/runtime:staging
```
I'll push a quick runtime tag once api + console are green.

sam_k: We should avoid multiple big merges at once. Propose merge order:
1) api #289 (owner @jon) — merge and publish swagger change
2) runtime image tag (jon) — push new tag referenced by helm values
3) helm chart bump infra/helm#12 (ops) — update image tag to new runtime
4) console #78 (frontend) — update client to new API shape
5) sdk #4321 (sdk) — final cut after api is live

maria: Sounds good. Can we do a short merge window tomorrow 09:00 PT? That gives time for tags and CI. @alex @jon can you confirm availability? :calendar:

alex: 09:00 PT works for me. I'll queue reviews and set a hold in the PRs so we don't accidentally merge early.

jon: I can be on hand. I'll also prepare a small rollback plan: if runtime image push fails we revert api change (small migration).

ci-bot: CI status for api#289: all checks passed — unit, lint. e2e pending on runtime tag.

maria: Great — I'll create a short merge checklist and post in #incidents during the window with exact PR links and who clicks merge. Also will add a post-merge smoke test list.

alex: One ask — can we add a short note in SDK changelog about the breaking param rename? SDK README already has a TODO. I can draft it tonight.

sam_k: I'll take helm chart approval after the runtime tag is pushed. Will also verify staging deploy before prod bump.

maria: Perfect. I'll post the merge window invite and ping again 30m before. Thanks all :party:
